Source: In a recent study, researchers were able to highlight how being infected with both hepatitis B (HBV) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) may offer a treatment advantage over infection with only HBV.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa emabegako, abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga engeri okubeera ne HBV ne HIV gye kiyinza okwanguya okujjanjabwa okusinga ku kubeera ne HBV yekka.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tí ó jáde láìpẹ́, àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ bí ó ti ṣeé ṣe kí kíkó àrùn hepatitis B (HBV) àti human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) mú ki ènìyàn ní àǹfààní ìtọ́jú ju ẹni tí ó ní HBV nìkan lọ.
Zulu: Ocwaningweni olusanda kwenziwa, abacwaningi bakwazi ukucacisa ukuthi ukutheleleka ngakho kokubili i-hepatitis B (i-HBV) kanye nesandulelangculaza (i-HIV) ingaletha usizo lokwelashwa olungaphezu kokutheleleka nge-HBV yodwa.
Hausa: A cikin binciken da aka yi kwanan nan, masu bincike sun sami damar bayyana yadda kamuwa da ciwon hanta na B (HBV) da cutar Ƙanjamau (HIV) suna iya bayar da fa’idar jiyya a kan kamuwa da cuta tare da HBV kaɗai.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše di sa tšwago go feta, banyakišiši ba ile ba kgona go laetša ka fao ge o fetetšwe ke bobedi hephathaethisi B (HBV) le baerase ya go palediša mašole a mmele go šoma (HIV) go ka bago le monyetla wa go hwetša kalafo go feta ge o fetetšwe fela ke HBV.
Amharic: በቅርብ በተደረገ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎች በሄፐታይተስ ቢ (ኤችቢቪ) እና በሂዩማን ኢሚዮኖ ዴፊሸንሲ ቫይረስ (ኤችአይቪ) በጋራ-ኢንፌክት መደረግ የኤችቢቪ ብቻ ኢንፌክሽንን ለማከም ጥቅም ሊሰጥ ይችላል፡፡

Source: In southern Africa, chronic infection with both HBV and HIV is a major problem.
Luganda: Mu Afirika ey’obukiikaddyo, okubeera ne HBV ne HIV ow’olukonvuba kizibu kya maanyi.
Yoruba: Ní apá Gúúsù ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà, àwọn àrùn arànmọ́ni tí ó burú jáì pẹ̀lú HBV àti HIV jẹ́ ìṣọ̀rò kan gbòógì.
Zulu: Eningizimu ne-Afrika, ukutheleleka okuyisimbelambela kwakokubili i-HBV ne-HIV kuyinkinga enkulu.
Hausa: A kudancin Afirka, kamuwa da cuta mai tsanani ta HBV da kuma HIV babbar matsala ce.
Northern Sotho: Ka borwa bja Afrika, phetetšo ye e sa folego ka ge o fetešwe ke HBV le HIV ke bothata bjo bogolo.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ በሁለቱም በኤችቢቪ እና በኤችአይቪ በጋራ ስር የሰደደ ኢንፌክሽን አስከፊ ችግር ነው፡፡

Source: Doctors need to understand how these viruses and the medications used to treat them interact with one another, so that they can better diagnose and care for patients.
Luganda: Abasawo beetaaga okutegeera engeri obuwuka buno n’eddagala eryeyambisibwa okubujjanjaba gye bikolaganamu, basobole okukebera n’okujjanjaba obulungi abalwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn Dókítà nílò láti ní òye bí àwọn kòkòrò àrun fáírọ́ọ̀sì wọ̀nyí àti àwọn ògùn tí a máa ń lò láti ṣe ìtójú wọn ṣe máa ń kan ara, kí wọn lè ṣe àyẹ̀wò àti ìtọ́jú àwọn aláìsàn bí ó ti tọ́.
Zulu: Odokotela badinga ukuqonda ukuthi la magciwane nemithi esetshenziswayo ukuwalapha kuhlangana kanjani, ukuze bezokwazi ukuhlonza izifo bephinde benakekele iziguli kangcono.
Hausa: Likitoci suna buƙatar fahimtar yadda waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta da magungunan da ake amfani da su don magance su suke cuɗar juna, ta yadda za su fi dacewa da ganewar asali da kuma kula da marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka di swanetše go kwešiša ka fao dibaerase tše le dihlare di šomišwago ka gona go alafa malwetši a di šomišanago mmgo, gore ba kgone go phekola bokaone le go hlokomela balwetši.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ታማሚዎችን በተሻለ መልኩ እንዲመረምሩ እና እንዲያክሙ እነዚህ ቫይረሶች እና እነሱን ለማከም የሚወሰዱት መድሃኒቶች እንዴት ጥቅም ላይ አንደሚውሉ እና ያላቸውን የእርስ በእርስ መስተጋብር መረዳት ይኖርባቸዋል፡፡

Source: Researchers wanted to compare the effects of therapy on patients who had HBV only, with patients who had both HBV and HIV.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okugeraageranya ebireetebwa obujjanjabi mu balwadde abaalina HBV yekka, n’abalwadde abaalina HBV ne HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ la†I ṣe àfiwé ipa tí tẹ́rápì ń kó lórih àwọn aláìsàn tí wọhn ní HBV nìkan, pẹ̀lú àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn ní HBV àti HIV.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babefuna ukuqhathanisa imiphumela yokwelashwa ezigulini ezazine-HBV yodwa, neziguli ezine-HBV ne-HIV kokubili.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun so kwatanta tasirin jiyya ga marasa lafiya waɗanda suke da HBV kaɗai, tare da marasa lafiya waɗanda suke da HBV da kuma HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go bapetša diabe tša kalafo ya balwetši bao ba bego ba na le HBV fela, le tša balwetši bao ba bego ba na le bobedi HBV le HIV.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ኤችቢቪ ብቻ ያለባቸውን ታማሚዎች ኤችቢቪ እና ኤችአይቪ በጋራ ካለባቸው ታማሚዎች ጋር በማወዳደር ህክምና በታማሚዎች ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: For this study the researchers recruited 115 adult patients with chronic hepatitis B infection (CHB).
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno abanoonyereza baakola n’abalwadde abakulu 115 abalina hepatitis B ow’olukonvuba (CHB).
Yoruba: Fún iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àkójọ àwọn aláisàn àgbàlagbà 115 tí wọ́n ní ìkọlù àrùn hepatitis B infection (CHB) tí ó burú jáì.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babuthe iziguli ezingabantu abadala eziyi-115 ezine-hepatitis B eyisimbelambela (i-CHB).
Hausa: Don wannan binciken, masu binciken sun ɗauki majinyata 115 manya masu fama da ciwon hanta na B mai tsanani (CHB).
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše banyakišiši ba ngwadišitše balwetši ba batho ba bagolo ba 115 bao ba nago le hephathaethisi B ya go se fole (CHB).
Amharic: ለዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ 115 ስር የሰደደ ሄፐታይተስ ቢ (ስ.ሄ.ኢ) ያለባቸውን አዋቂ ታማማዎች መልምለዋል፡፡

Source: They were recruited from Tygerberg hospital in Cape Town, South Africa.
Luganda: Baggyibwa mu ddwaliro lya Tygerberg mu Cape Town, South Afirika.
Yoruba: Láti ilé ìwòsàn Tygerberg tí ó wà ní Cape Town, ní South Africa ni wọ́n ti ṣà wọn jọ.
Zulu: Babuthwa esibhedlela i-Tygerberg eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: An ɗauke su aiki daga asibitin Tygerberg a Cape Town, Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba ngwadišwa go tšwa ka sepetleleng sa Tygerberg ka Cape Town, Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: የተመለመሉትም ከደቡብ አፍሪካ ኬፕ ታውን ታይገርበርግ ሆስፒታል ነበር፡፡

Source: Some patients were infected with HIV (39) and the rest were only infected with HBV.
Luganda: Abalwadde abamu baalina HIV (39) ate abalala baalina HBV yekka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn kan wà tí wọn rí ìkọlù àrùn HIV (39), bẹ́ẹ̀ ni àwọn tih oh kù ni ìkọlù pẹ̀lú HBV nìkan.
Zulu: Ezinye iziguli zazitheleleke nge-HIV (39) kanti ezinye zazitheleleke nge-HBV yodwa.
Hausa: Wasu marasa lafiya (39) sun kamu da cutar HIV sauran kuma sun kamu da cutar HBV kaɗai.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba bangwe ba ile ba fetelwa ke HIV (39) gomme ba bangwe ka moka ba ile ba fetelwa ke HBV.
Amharic: አንዳንድ ታማሚዎች በኤችአይቪ (39) የቀሩት ደግሞ በኤችቢቪ ብቻ ኢንፌክት ተደርገው ነበር፡፡

Source: Researchers looked at race, age and sex, and conducted various clinical and laboratory tests.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baatunuulira langi, emyaka n’ekikula, ne bakola okukebera okw’enjawulo okw’ekisawo ne mu ggezeserezo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí wo ẹ̀yà, ọjọ́ orí, àti ìdá àkọ-n-bábo, wọ́n sì ṣe àyẹ̀wò ajẹmọ ìṣègùn àti àwọn àyẹ̀wò inú láàbù.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babheka ibala, iminyaka kanye nobulili, base benza izinhlolo eziningana zezempilo nezaselabhorethri.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun duba launin fata da shekaru da kuma jinsi, kuma sun gudanar da gwaje-gwajen asibiti da na ɗakin gwaje-gwaje daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba lebelela mohlobo, mengwaga le bong gomme ba dira diteko ta mehutahuta tša kalafi le tša ka laporathoring.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ዘር፣ እድሜ እና ጾታን የዳሰሱ ሲሆን ብዙ ክሊኒካዊ እና የላብራቶሪ ሙከራዎችን አድርገዋል፡፡

Source: They found that patients who only had HBV were less likely to be on any form of antiviral treatment, showing natural symptoms of liver disease (since HBV is a virus that may cause severe liver disease).
Luganda: Baakizuula nti abalwadde abaalina HBV yekka baali basuubirwa kitono okubeera ku ddagala ly’obuwuka, nga balaga obubonero bw’obulwadde bw’ekibumba (olw’okuba nga HBV kabonero akayinza okuleeta obulwadde bw’ekibumba obw’amaanyi).
Yoruba: Wọn ríí pé kò wọ́pọ̀ kí àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn ní HBV nìkan wà lórí ìtọ́jú agbógun ti àrùn arànmọ́ni, tí ó sì ṣe àfihàn àmì àìsàn ẹ̀dọ̀ (nígbàtí ó jẹ́ wí pé HBV jẹ́ kòkòrò àrùn fáírọ́ìsì tí ó lè ṣe okùnfà àìsàn ẹ̀dọ̀ tí ó burú jáì).
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi iziguli ezazine-HBV yodwa zazinamathuba amancane okuthi kube nokulashwa abangaphansi kwakho, okukhombisa izimpawukugula zemvelo sesifo sesibindi (njengoba i-HBV iyigciwane elingaholela esifweni sesibindi esibi kakhulu).
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa marasa lafiya waɗanda suke da HBV kaɗai ba su da yiwuwar kasancewa a kan kowane nau’i na maganin rigakafi, suna nuna alamun cututtukan hanta (tunda HBV ƙwayar cuta ce wacce za ta iya haifar da cutar hanta mai tsanani).
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore balwetši bao ba fetetšwego fela ke HBV go be go na le kgonagalo ye nnyane ya gore ba ka nwa dihlare tša go lwantšha baerase, ba bontšha maswao a tlhago a bolwetši bja sebete (ka ge HBV e le baerase ye e ka bakago bolwetši bja sebete bjo bo kekilego).
Amharic: ኤችቢቪ ብቻ ያለባቸው ታማሚዎች የጸረ-ኤችአይቪ ህክምና የመውስድ አዝማሚያቸው አነስተኛ እንደሆነ ያገኙ ሲሆን ፣ የጉበት በሽታ ተፈጥሯዊ ምልክቶችንም ያሳያሉ ( ይህ የሆነው የኤችቢቪ ቫይረስ የከፋ የጉበት በሽታን ሊያስከትል ስለሚችል ነው)፡፡

Source: The researchers were able to show that individuals with HBV only were at a disadvantage when compared to those with both HIV and HBV, as patients infected with both viruses were likely to be on antiviral HIV treatment, which also offers some benefit in combating HBV infection.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga nti abantu abalina HBV yekka baalina obuzibu bw’ogeraageranya n’abo abalina HIV ne HBV, olw’okuba ng’abalwadde abalina obuwuka bwombi baali basuubirwa okubeera ku ddagala ly’akawuka ka HIV, nga lino era lisobola n’okulwanyisa akawuka ka HBV.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àfihàn pé àwọn ọlọ́danni tí wọ́n ní àrùn HBV nìkan kò ní lè jẹ́ àwọn àǹfààní kọ̀ọ̀kan tí a bá fi wọ́n wé àwọn alaìsàn tí wọn ní àrùn HBV àti HIV, bí ó ti jẹ́ pé ó ṣẹéṣe kí àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ń dojúkọ àrùn méjèèjì wọ̀nyí wà lórí ìlò ọ̀gùn ìdènà ìtànkálẹ̀ kòkò HIV, èyí tí ó tún ní àǹfààní ìgbógunti ìkọlù HBV.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV yodwa babekhinyabezeka uma beqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV ne-HBV kokubili, njengoba iziguli eziphathwe yiwo omabili amagciwane babenamathuba okuthola ukwelashwa kwe–HIV, okuza nenzuzo ethila ekulweni nesifo se-HBV.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun iya nuna cewa mutanen da suke ɗauke da HBV kaɗai sun kasance a cikin rashin lafiya idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda suke ɗauke da ƙwayar cutar HIV da kuma HBV, kamar yadda majinyata da suka kamu da ƙwayar cutar za su kasance a kan maganin cutar HIV, wanda kuma yana ba da wata fa’ida a cikin yaƙi da cutar HBV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba kgona go laetša gore batho bao ba fetetšwego ke HBV fela ba be ba na le monyetla ge ba bapetšwa le bao ba fetetšwego ke bobedi HIV le HBV, ka ge balwetši bao ba fetetšwego ke dibaerase tše ka bobedi go be go na le kgonagalo ya gore ba ka be ba enwa dihlare tša go lwantšha baerase ya HIV, gomme se gape se fana ka kholego go lwantšha phetetšo ya HBV.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ማሳየት እንደቻሉት በኤችቢቪ ብቻ የተያዙ ሰዎች ኤችአይቪ እና ኤችቢቪ በጋራ ከተያዙ ሰዎች ጋር ሲወዳደሩ የከፋ ጉዳት ሊደርስባቸው ይችላል፡፡ ይህም የሚሆነው በሁለቱም ቫይረሶች ኢንፌክት የተደረጉ ታማሚዎች የጸረ-ኤችአይቪ ህክምና የመውሰድ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ ስለሆነ ነው ይህ ደግሞ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽንን ለመዋጋት የተወሰኑ ጥቅሞችን ይሰጣል፡፡

Source: The results from this study highlight the potential impact of differences between referral, monitoring and treatment options for HBV when compared to HIV and HBV coinfection, which favours those infected with both HIV and HBV.
Luganda: Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno biraga ebiyinza okuva mu njawukana wakati w’okuweereza malwaliro agasingako, okulondoola n’okujjanjaba abalina HBV bw’ogeraageranya n’abalina HIV ne HBV, ng’abalina HIV ne HBV be basingako okuganyulwa.
Yoruba: Èsì láti ara iṣẹ́ ìwadìí yìí ṣe àfihàn ipa ìyàtọ̀ tí ó wà láàárín ìfiránṣẹ́, àbojútó àti ìtọ́jú fún HBV ní ìgbàtí a bá ṣe àfiwé rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àkópọ̀ ìkọlù HIV àti HBV, èyí tí ó ní àǹfààní fún àwọn tí ó ní HIV àti HBV.
Zulu: Imiphumela evela kulolu cwaningo icacisa imphumela ongase ube ukhona womehluko phakathi kwezinketho zokubikwa, ukuqashwa kanye nokulashwa ze-HBV uma ziqhataniswa nokuphathwa yi-HIV ne-HBV ngesikhathi esisodwa, okuvuna labo abaphethwe yokokubili i-HIV ne-HBV.
Hausa: Sakamako daga wannan binciken yana nuna yiwuwar tasirin bambance-bambance tsakanin turawa da saka-idanu da zaɓuɓɓukan magani na Ciwon Hanta na B idan aka kwatanta da ƙwayar cutar HIV da kuma HBV wanda yake fifita waɗanda suka kamu da cutar HIV da kuma HBV.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo go tšwa dinyakišišong tše di laeditše kgonagalo ya seabe sa diphapano magareng ga go romela balwetši go yo hwetša kalafo, go ba hlokomela le dikgetho tša go hwetša kalafo ya HBV ge ba bapetšwa le phetetšommogo ya HIV le HBV, gomme se sa fa bao ba fetetšwego ke bobedi HIV le HBV monyetla.
